Ari Chen: Heads-up — uploaded final edits to the 'Time Off & Exceptions' handbook section. Changes: clarified opt-in exception flow for partial PTO payouts, added manager ack requirement, and normalized payroll codes. Managers please ack by COB Friday.

Samir Patel: Quick Qs — 1) Do exceptions require a written business justification in the HR casework? 2) Will Payroll need a specific exception code for partial payouts?

Lee Gomez: Yes on #1 — require a short justification entered into the case record. For #2 — Payroll needs code EX-PTP for partial payout, EX-MED for medical exceptions. I added both to the ack form.

Maya Rivera: Where's the manager ack form? I scanned the doc but didn't see an obvious link.

Ari Chen: Link is at top-right of the handbook page and prefilled for managers. Pasted the checklist here:
Ari Chen: ```
Manager ack checklist:
- Confirm employee notified
- Attach justification doc (case id)
- Select exception code (EX-PTP or EX-MED)
- Submit -> People Ops review
```

Nora Li: Small ask — can we add a 'requires exec review' flag for partial payouts > 4 weeks? We hit that edge case in recruiting ops last month.

Lee Gomez: Good call. Added a note: Exec review required for payouts > 4 weeks. Updated handbook clause 3.4 and the ack form now surfaces the flag.

Maya Rivera: Acked — submitted form for my report (case: 2026-1457). @Ari Chen please confirm receipt when you get a chance.

Ari Chen: Received — I'll triage tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
